Name: Happ Toggle
Description: Toggle Happ VPN and test connection speed. Select a test service by key or dial; display VPN status and measured speed on Stream Deck+ and Neo.

com.llwhite.happtoggle.toggle.Name: Happ VPN
com.llwhite.happtoggle.toggle.Tooltip: Toggle Happ VPN and display status. Hold to test connection speed.

com.llwhite.happtoggle.speed.Name: Speed Test
com.llwhite.happtoggle.speed.Tooltip: Short press starts/cancels a test. Hold the key to cycle services; hold the dial to toggle VPN. Rotate to select a service, tap to toggle VPN. Neo screen displays status and results.

inspector.iconHint: PNG/JPG/GIF/SVG images are cropped to 144×144. Reset restores the built-in icon.
inspector.appearanceHint: Hiding units does not hide the numbers. Speed updates during the test; this is not live traffic. Fonts come from Windows with a fallback if unavailable.
inspector.manualSpeed: Short press starts a test; press again to cancel. Hold the idle key to cycle Yandex → Cloudflare → Speedtest.net. The choice is saved for this key; it is not the Happ VPN server.
inspector.manualEncoder: Rotate to select a test service; short press starts/cancels on release; hold (0.6 s by default) or tap the screen to toggle Happ VPN. The screen shows status and measured speed, not live traffic. Results remain until the next test, service or VPN change. Transparency removes the plugin fill; the actual background depends on Stream Deck. This is a test service, not the Happ VPN server.
inspector.manualNeo: Neo Infobar displays VPN status and tests started by a key on the same device. Also place Speed Test on a regular key: short press starts/cancels, hold cycles services. Infobar does not accept presses. Results remain until the next test, source service or VPN change. Transparency removes the plugin fill; the actual background depends on Stream Deck. Requires Stream Deck 7.6+.
inspector.manualToggle: With auto-test off, hold the VPN key for over 0.6 s or add a separate Speed Test action.
